Commentary.Commentary: So this ends the proceedings of today's match. England make it three wins in three and top the Group A table. Along with them, beating all the odds, Bangladesh go through to the semis. Tomorrow, we have the first do-or-die clash from Group B as South Africa take on India for a place in the semis. The match will take place at The Oval and will start at 1030 local (0930 GMT). Do join us for it. Until then, take care! Cheers!

Steven Smith says that the loss is very disappointing. Admits they did not play well and lost too many wickets in between which they can't do against a top team like England. On being asked whether it was because of his batsmen not spending much time in the middle, he says that it cannot be used as a reason. Reckons the balance of the team was very good but the players did not stand up. Feels that a lot has not gone their way (talking about the weather). Admits they were not at their best with the ball after the break and they gave away some freebies to Stokes and Morgan but at the same time praises the pair as well for their outstanding partnership.

Eoin Morgan says that things have been going pretty well for his team and they have been slightly lucky as well. Adds that they did a reasonable job today as they took the game away from Australia when they were in command. Applauds his bowlers for restricting the opposition to a below par total. On Mark Wood's recent scalps, he feels that it takes a high quality bowler to take the wickets of some of the best batsmen in the world. Calls it a tough tournament and everyone has to be at their very best. On the talk between him and Stokes after being 3 down quickly, he replies that they told each other, it was a great wicket and they needed to get a partnership going.

Man of the Match, Ben Stokes says that his training has been consistent and he has been timing the ball well. Adds that they wanted to get on with the game during the first rain break. Praises Eoin Morgan for his knock and says that he has been in great form and hopes that he continues his good work and the team plays around him. Informs that the Indian T20 League experience helped him to play under pressure situation and in front of huge crowd. On his injury, he replies that he is in good nick and is feeling good about his fitness.

Eoin Morgan and Ben Stokes came out with a very positive attitude and took the attack to the Australian bowlers. They started hitting the ball to all parts of the ground and stitched a 159-run partnership at better than run-a-ball. The former scored 87 before getting run out and it looked like there would be a twist in tale. However, Jos Buttler came out and never let the momentum slip. Stokes carried on and scored a century before the rain returned again.

Coming back to the chase, the Aussie bowlers started off really well getting rid of the English top order early. They were on top at that moment but rain halted the proceedings. Luckily, it was a passing shower and the game resumed soon. However, England regrouped and looked a completely different side after the break.

So, Australia the world champions have been knocked out of the Champions Trophy and that too at the hands of their arch rivals, England. Once again rain intervened, not once but twice. The first delay broke their momentum but by the time rain had the final say, the hosts were ahead of the DLS par score.
UPDATE 1840 LOCAL TIME - The news from the middle has arrived and it's not a good one as the match has been called off. ENGLAND WIN BY 40 RUNS (DLS METHOD)!

PLAY HALTED - As we mentioned earlier, the drizzle had started. Now, it has got heavier and so the umpires have decided to go off the field. England played some superb cricket in the last hour or so and hence they are well ahead of the DLS par score for now, which is 200! The next update will be at 1830 local time.
Pushed slightly quicker through the air, clipped to mid-wicket.
3rd ODI hundred for Ben Stokes.

FOUR! Century for Ben Stokes! Shorter and spinning away Stokes goes back and slashes it hard through covers. Beats the man in the deep to collect another boundary. What a knock it has been from him! He came at a time when England were struggling but played a superb counter-attacking cricket with his skipper Morgan. He truly deserves this ton.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now 5 players are allowed outside the circle. It has started to drizzle.
Full ball on middle, Buttler flicks it to mid-wicket. 42 required now off 60 balls.
Lands it on a length on off, Buttler defends it off the front foot.
Comes down the track to the length ball and slaps it through covers for a run.
Hurls it on a length outside off, Buttler guides it down to third man for a run.
Bowls it on a length, the ball jags back in a little. Buttler defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on middle, Stokes pulls it through square leg for a run.
Josh Hazlewood comes onto bowl.
Full ball, Buttler drives it straight back to the bowler.
SIX! TONKED! Zampa tosses it up, Buttler just hits it over long on for a biggie. England are cruising at the moment.
Drags his length back outside off, Buttler cuts it straight to backward point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stokes comes down the track and hits it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls it on the pads, Stokes plays it to short fine leg.
Drinks are on the field.
Back of a length on off, Buttler defends it off the back foot to point.
Length ball on the pads, Stokes flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
BOUNCER! Bowls a bouncer, Buttler looks to pull but ducks under it at the last moment. The umpire calls it first for the over.
Bowls a well-directed short delivery. Buttler goes for the pull but is beaten for pace and misses it.
Back of a length on the stumps, Buttler pulls it through square leg for a run.
Pat Cummins is back on to bowl.
Short outside off, Buttler plays the square cut straight to point.

FOUR! Tosses it up outside off, Buttler drags it to Cummins at long on, who runs in and it falls just short of him. He gets an awkward bounce in front of him and so takes his eyes off it. The ball hits him on the leg and goes to the fence.
Punches the ball down to long on for a single.
Tosses it on off, Stokes plays it to the point region.
FOUR! Bowls a wrong one but pitches it short. Stokes rocks back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Tosses it up on off, Stokes drives it back to the bowler.
Bowls a full toss on off, Buttler pushes it to mid off.
Full ball, Stokes pushes it through covers for a run.
Very full ball, Stokes squeezes it to mid on.
Full ball on off, Buttler drives it to mid off for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease

FOUR! Maxwell makes a mess of a catch. Back of a length ball outside off, Buttler cuts it uppishly through point. It travels at a catchable height to Maxwell but he loses the sight of it. It goes through him for a boundary. Buttler will consider himself lucky.
Stokes pushes the ball on off to covers.
Drags his length back a little, Stokes pulls it to mid-wicket off the back foot.
Floats it on off, Buttler drives it through covers for a run.
Tosses it on off, Buttler punches it through cover-point for a couple.
Bowls a wrong one on off, Stokes defends it to cover and they scamper through for a run. Maxwell has a shy at the stumps at the striker's end but misses.
Bowls it full on off, Buttler goes down on one knee and sweeps it to fine leg for a run.
Hurls it on a length on off, Buttler pushes it through covers for a run.
Length ball on off, Buttler defends it off the front foot.
Full toss on the pads, Stokes flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Bowls it full on off, Buttler drives it through cover for a run.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Buttler drives it through covers for a boundary.
Zampa bowls it down the leg side, Buttler sweeps it to fine leg for a run.
Fires it in on middle, Buttler cuts it to point.
Bowls it on the stumps, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
Comes down the track a little and hits it to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up, Buttler drives it to mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Adam Zampa is brought back into the attack.
Full toss ball on off, Buttler glides it to third man for a single.
Jos Buttler comes into bat.

OUT! Australia get the breakthrough courtesy a run out. And I guess that was the only way this partnership could have been broken. Starc bowls a full slower ball, Stokes is early into the drive and chips it on the bounce to Zampa at mid on. He sets off for a run but Morgan is ball-watching and they both are almost stranded at one end. Morgan, however, decides to go for the run. Adam scores a direct hit at the striker's end and Eoin is a long way out. It was a special, special effort from the Aussie leggie. The keeper hadn't got to the stumps and so he needed to score a direct hit to get rid of the English skipper. He does that and brings the 159-run partnership to an end. Can there be a twist?
YORKER! Tailing in, Stokes digs it out to point.
Hurls it on a length on off, Stokes pushes it back to the bowler off the front foot.
Bowls a yorker on leg stump, Morgan works it through square leg for a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, Morgan tries to drive it but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls to mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, Stokes plays it to the point region.
BEATEN! Bowls it on a length from over the wicket. The ball nips away from the deck a little. Stokes goes for the drive but is beaten.
Comes around the wicket, angles it in on off, Morgan defends it off the front foot.
Short ball on the body, Stokes pulls it behind square leg for a run.
Length ball on the pads, Stokes flicks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! SHOT! Full toss outside off, Stokes just times it through covers for a boundary. These two are playing shots with utter ease.
Pat Cummins comes back into the attack.
Again Starc looks for a yorker, ends up bowling it very full on leg, Stokes flicks it through square leg for a single.
Very full on middle and leg, clipped to mid-wicket.
Almost a yorker on the stumps, Stokes does well to dig it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a brace. This brings up the 150-run stand between Stokes and Morgan!
Fuller length delivery on middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Mitchell Starc is back on!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

SIX! Morgan on fire! Length delivery, angling away, Morgan dances down the track. Has to reach slightly to heave it away on the leg side. Doesn't connect it off the middle but it still goes the distance to clear the mid-wicket fence.
Length delivery on middle and off, defended to covers.
Back of a length around leg, tucked over mid-wicket for a single.
Stokes charges down the track and punches it hard on the off side. Henriques at extra cover is sharp and dives to his left to make a superb stop.
Pitched in the line of the stumps, punched to mid off.
Wide outside off, Morgan glides it with hard hands past backward point. Hazlewood in the deep, covers good ground to his right and keeps it down to two.
Length delivery around middle and off, defended from within the crease.
FOUR! Slashed away! Back of a length delivery, angling across Morgan. He makes full use of the width on offer as he slaps it past backward point for a boundary. England need 103 from 134 balls!
Well-directed bouncer! Banged in short, Morgan looks to hook it but it's quick for him and so he misses.
Back of a length around off, Stokes places it to mid off and takes a quick single.
A touch ahead of a length, around off, angling away, Stokes looks to slash it hard but gets an under edge, into the ground and to the keeper.
Straying on the pads, Stokes gets across and tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length on the stumps, punched back to the bowler, who half-stops it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Again slightly ahead of a length, driven back to the bowler.
Fuller delivery, Stokes looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards point.
Josh Hazlewood comes back from the other end.
Angling away from Stokes, he slashes hard at it but gets a thick outside edge towards third man for a single.
Full outside off, drilled hard to mid off.
Ahead of length, angling away, Stokes looks to play it on the up but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Length delivery, angling away, driven on the up to covers.
FOUR! Wristy! Sligthly back of a length on middle, Stokes stays tall and whips it past mid on for a boundary. That was all wrist work. Beautiful!
Length delivery, angling away, cut through cover-point for a single.
Pat Cummins is back on!
Served around middle and leg, worked through mid on for a single.
Stokes dances down the wicket and drills it on the full to long on for a single.
Full delivery, Stokes goes hard at it but finds the man at covers.

SIX! Stokes power! Full in the line of the stumps, Stokes hits it with brute force over long on. It's flat and traveling and Zampa shouts 'catch it'. Warner in the deep, leaps, stretches his left hand but can't get to the ball. That's another maximum for the English all-rounder.
On the pads, clipped to fine leg for a single.
Wide! Quicker one but down the leg side. Morgan leaves it at the last moment. A wide is signalled!
Punched off the back foot through mid on for a single.

SIX! This is poor from Maxwell! He once again bowls a short delivery, sliding in. Morgan camps back and pulls it handsomely over mid-wicket for a maximum. This will be so frustrating for the Aussie skipper.
Short outside off, Morgan makes room and cuts it to backward point.
Sliding down leg, Morgan prods forward to defend but misses and gets rapped on the pads.
Full outside off, milked past Maxwell, through mid off for a single.
Arm ball, a touch shorter, Stokes goes back and looks to heave it hard but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full outside off, Morgan strides forward and eases it through wide mid off for a single.
Drinks break!
Stokes dances down the track and drives it back to the bowler.
Slider on the shorter side, Stokes goes back to work but misses and gets rapped on the pads.
Poor effort from Zampa! Googly, punched off the back foot to the left of Zampa, who misfields and concedes a single.
Full on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
FOUR! Innovative! Full outside off, Morgan reverse sweeps through to the third man fence. What a superb display of batting we are witnessing!
Stokes charges down the wicket, looks to go big but bunts it off the inner half to long on for a single.
Straighter one, punched off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Slider from Maxwell, skids through and Morgan is a touch late to bring his bat down. Gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full and sliding in, Morgan defends it off the front foot to mid-wicket.
Arm ball from Maxwell, worked on the leg side.
Sliding into the pads, Morgan fails to flick it and the ball goes off the pads down the leg side.
100-run stand between Morgan and Stokes!

SIX! Huge! Short ball to start with. Morgan camps back and pulls it hard over wide long on for a maximum. This has been some batting after the break from England. They are cruising through at the moment.
Glenn Maxwell replaces Starc, who has walked off the field.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Zampa drags his length back, Stokes makes room and slashes it through covers for a boundary. You just can't bowl this short to Ben Stokes!
Flipper, sliding across, punched past the diving extra cover fielder for a single.
Served on middle and off, driven to long off for a single.
Full outside off, Stokes plays with hard hands but straight to the man at covers.
Tossed up on middle, defended off the front foot.
Attempts a yorker but ends up being a low full toss. Morgan digs it out well.
Low full toss on the pads, Stokes flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drifts on the pads, Stokes flicks it to mid-wicket.
ALMOST! Nothing is going Australia's way. Bowls it full outside off, Morgan checks his drive and the ball just goes wide of the cover fielder for a run.
Length ball on off, Morgan plays it to the point region.
Bowls it on the stumps, Stokes plays it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
34th ODI fifty for Morgan.
Tosses it up on leg stump, Morgan drives it to long on for a run. The skipper brings up his fifty. He was dropped on 10 by Wade and it is proving costly for Australia.
Gives it air on off stump, Stokes drives it through mid off for a run.
Drags his length back a little, Morgan tucks it to square leg for a run.
Runs down the track and drives it to mid on.
Adam Zampa comes into bowl.
Full ball on middle, Stokes flicks it to mid-wicket.
10th ODI fifty for Ben Stokes.

SIX! OH MY! What a shot there. Short ball on the stumps, Stokes just belts it over the backward square leg fence for a maximum. This also brings up his fifty. This has been a brilliant attacking half century by Stokes.
Full on the stumps, Stokes drives it to mid on.
Adam Zampa is seen warming up!
Just ahead of a length, Stokes drives it back to the bowler.
Short of a length, Morgan pushes it through covers for a run.
Back of a length ball on middle, Morgan defends it off the back foot.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Up and over! Full ball angling into the batsman, Stokes lifts it over mid on who stretches his hand but can't reach it. The ball races away to the fence.
Short ball on the stumps, Stokes pulls it but does not get it off the middle. It goes through mid-wicket for a couple.
Hurls it on a length on off, Stokes defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stokes comes down to the track and tries to push at the ball outside off but misses.
Moises Henriques comes onto bowl.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Darts it on the stumps, Morgan punches it down to long on for a run.
Bowls it on off, Morgan drives it to cover.
Stokes drives the flighted ball down to long on for a run.
Floats it on off, Morgan drives it through covers for a run.
Tosses it up, Morgan drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! WHAT TIMING! Cummins bowls it full outside off, Stokes drives it through covers for a boundary. A good over for England. 13 runs off it.
JUST SHORT! The change to around the wicket almost worked. Bowls it on a length outside off, Stokes checks his drive and the ball falls just short of Henriques at covers.
FOUR! Two boundaries in the over. Full toss on the stumps, Stokes flicks it through mid-wicket for another boundary. England are racing along here.
Bowls it full and wide outside off, Stokes slaps it to mid off.
FOUR! It's raining boundaries! Full and wide outside off, Stokes slashes at it and gets it over point for another boundary.
Short and wide outside off, Morgan cuts it to deep point for a run.
Fires it in on off, Stokes punches it off the back foot to covers.
FOUR! Poor ball, punished! Head bowls a full toss on the pads of Stokes, who flicks it behind square leg for a boundary.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Bowls it on the stumps, Stokes flicks it uppishly to mid-wicket.
Tosses it outside off, Morgan drives it through covers for a run.
Bowls it full on the stump, Morgan digs it out back to the bowler off the inner half.
Travis Head comes into the attack.
Full ball on off, Stokes drives it hard to mid off where Starc misfields and the batsmen pick two. 50-run stand is up between Stokes and Morgan!
FOUR! Stokes looks so good when he plays this shot. Length ball on the stumps. Stokes pushes it straight back past the bowler for a boundary.
Full and wide outside off, Morgan just throws his hands and it. The ball goes through cover-point for a run.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Stokes pushes it through covers for a run. These two are ticking along well.
Just ahead of a length, Stokes plays it off the front foot.
Lands it on a length outside off, Morgan tries to cut but gets an underedge and the ball rolls to point.
Back of a length ball on the stumps, Stokes drives it to mid on.
Hurls it on a length outside off, Morgan pushes it through the off side for a run.
Comes down the track to the length ball but chops it in covers.
SIX! THAT IS HUGE! Hazlewood bangs it short, Morgan goes for the pull but gets a top edge into the stands for a biggie. You can't be bowling short at this pace.
Length ball on middle, Morgan defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it on the pads, Stokes walks down the pitch and flicks it behind square leg for a single.
Shorter in length on the body of Morgan, he defends it off the back foot onto the ground.
Length ball outside off, Stokes pushes it through covers for a run.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Short this time, Stokes goes for a pull but gets a top edge and the ball goes to the fine leg boundary.
FOUR! CLASSY SHOT! Full on middle, Stokes just flicks it to the left of mid on and the ball races away to the fence.
Length ball on the pads, Stokes flicks it behind square leg for a couple.
Length ball, Stokes plays it off the back foot.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the circle till the end of 40th over.
Pitched on middle and leg, defended solidly.
Angling away from Morgan, defended in the cover region.
SIX! Boom! Short delivery and Morgan latches onto it in a flash. Pulls hard over square leg for a biggie. He moves to 34 with that!
Now Stokes advances down the track and plays it across the line wide of mid on for a single.
Length delivery, angling away, Stokes shimmies a touch and tucks it to forward square leg.
Fuller length delivery around off, angling away, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Back of a length delivery in line of the stumps, defended solidly down the wicket. Maiden to begin with by Pat Cummins!
It's on length again, Morgan dabs it to backward point.
Good surprise delivery, this! Cummins comes steaming in and bowls a bouncer at 140 kph. Morgan ducks under it to let it sail through.
Full on middle and off, driven off the middle but straight to mid off again.
Length delivery, angling away, Morgan looks to advance down the track but then halts and blocks it on the off side.
Full around off, driven nicely but straight to mid off.
Pat Cummins is the first change bowler.
Length delivery, angling away, punched with the angle to covers.
Around leg, Stokes pushes it to mid on.
First ball Stokes faces after the break and he punches it nicely on the up. Gets it past mid off but it doesn't have legs to travel all the way. A brace is collected.
Morgan gives charge to this length delivery, has a heave at it but gets an inside edge. The ball travels to fine leg for a single.
Length delivery, angling away, Morgan leaves it alone.

FOUR! In the air but in the gap! Another full delivery outside off, Morgan looks to drive it off the front foot again but mistimes it. Ends up slicing it through point for a boundary. The English skipper seems to have decided to go after the Australian bowling.
Short outside off, Morgan gets on his toes, rides the bounce to guide it to third man for a single.
Wide outside off, Morgan slashes hard at it but misses. He should have cut that away reckons Atherton on air.
Banged in short, angling in, Morgan ducks underneath it.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed to point.

FOUR! Almost a replica! The break hasn't done any harm to Morgan's concentration it seems. He needs no time to settle again. Times this full delivery through covers to perfection for another boundary.
FOUR! Beautiful start after the resumption! Full outside off, Morgan drives it off the front foot through covers for a boundary. Smith shakes his head in disappointment.
The umpires have made their way back on the field. Australia, who were already near the ropes have quickly taken their fielding positions. Mitchell Starc to continue.

The Australian players are already near the boundary line. They are very eager to come out and play. After picking three early wickets, they have the momentum on their side and would hope to run through England's batting. 20 overs, yes that's the mark the second innings need to reach to constitute a game. The Aussies will be wishing to reach there quickly.
UPDATE 1530 LOCAL TIME - The match will resume at 1545 local time. There will be no overs lost which is a good news for the Australians.

The players are walking of the field as the drizzle has gotten heavier. These are not good signs for the Aussies. They would not want this game to be abandoned. Let us all hope it is just a passing shower.
Length delivery in the line of the stumps, Stokes defends it carefully.

Huge appeal for lbw! Pitched around leg, angling towards the stumps, Stokes looks to play across the line but is beaten and gets rapped on the pads. The Aussies appeal in unison but it's turned down. Smith has a discussion with his bowler and keeper for the review but doesn't take it.
Ben Stokes is the new man in.

OUT! Big wicket! That's what the doctor ordered for Australia! Pitched a touch ahead of length outside off, nips away slightly. Root prods forward to defend but again is undone by the slight away movement. The ball catches the outside edge and it's an easy catch for Wade behind the stumps. England in huge trouble. For the first time in this tournament, they have been rocked early and so hard. Hazlewood is on fire! He has produced some exceptional deliveries today.

Shout for lbw! On a length outside off, Root gets across and down the pitch. Looks to flick but misses and the ball goes off the pads down the leg side. There's a huge appeal for lbw but it's turned down. The replays show that it had hit Root high on the pads and would have gone on to miss the stumps. A couple of leg byes are taken.
It has started to drizzle. The groundsmen are getting ready with the covers.
Beaten! Peach of a delivery from Hazlewood! Pitched on a length, straightens a touch. Root looks to defend with the angle but gets beaten by the movement off the deck.
Angling down leg, Root gets across and works it through mid-wicket. Head there misfields and the batsmen collect a brace.
Full outside off, Morgan plays a superb drive but once again finds the man at point.
Full outside off, driven to point.
Length delivery on the stumps, defended from within the crease.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full outside off, Root drives it nicely through covers for three runs.

FOUR! Through the slips! Slanting away from Root, he looks to push it on the off side with soft hands but gets an outside edge. The ball falls short of the slip cordon and goes through first and second slip to the fence behind.

DROPPED! Short down the leg side, Morgan looks to pull it away but gets a glove on it. The ball goes to the right of Wade, who dives full stretch, gets gloves to it but fails to hang onto it. The ball ricochets behind and a brace is taken. Reprieve for Morgan here! 14 from the here!

FOUR! Straight back! Pitched in the line of the stumps, Morgan drives it past the bowler. Beats the man at mid on and the ball races to the fence. The English skipper has already scored three boundaries.
Angling away from Morgan, pushed to covers.

FOUR! Toying with the bowler's length! Length delivery, angling away, Morgan makes room and slaps it through cover-point for a boundary. With the use of the feet in the previous delivery, Morgan has made Hazlewood to alter his length here.
FOUR! Counter-attack! Full outside off, Morgan dances down the track and plays a smashing drive past mid off for a boundary.
Slightly back of a length, angling away, dabbed to point.
Wide outside off, Root makes the wise decision of leaving it alone.
FOUR! Creamed it! Full outside off, Root leans into the shot and drives it crisply through covers for a boundary. That was timed superbly!
Full on middle, a hint of inswing, driven to mid on.
Fuller around off, pushed to mid off.
Slanting away from Root, he leaves it.
Full and angling away, pushed with the angle to point.
Another leave by Morgan to see off Hazlewood's first over.
Pitched outside off, Morgan makes a watchful leave.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, left alone.
The skipper Eoin Morgan walks out to bat. They need a big partnership going now.

OUT! Edged and gone! The Aussies are off to a superb start! Good length delivery around off, angling in, straightens a touch after pitching. Hales looks to defend with a straight bat but gets an outside edge which goes straight to Aaron Finch at first slip, who pouches it with ease. That was a superb delivery to get rid of the in-form Hales.
Full length delivery, angling in, straightens a touch. Root looks to clip but gets a leading edge which goes in the gap in covers for a run.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. End of a successful first over from Starc!
Slanting away from Hales, pushed to mid off.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full, swinging in a touch, clipped to fine leg for a single. Root is off the mark straightaway!
Joe Root once again arrives early in the middle.

OUT! Decision stays! Another failure for Jason Roy! He has been under criticism for a long time and it was a good stage for him to answer them but has failed to do so. Coming to the ball, it was pitched around leg, straightens a touch after pitching. Roy looks to flick it on the leg side but is late to bring his bat down in time. Gets rapped on the pads and the players go up in appeal. Umpire Dharamasena after a thought, raises his finger and Roy straightaway opts for the review. The Hawk Eye shows that it pitched on leg, impact was in line and was going on to hit the stumps. Superb decision, that! Starc has given Aussies the perfect start.
Jason Roy has been adjudged lbw. He though has opted for the review!
FOUR! Gift from Starc! Full toss around off, Roy times it beautifully past mid off for a boundary. Just the start England wanted.
The players are out on the field for chase. Jason Roy and Alex Hales to open for England. Mitchell Starc to start with the first new ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...
